text:
alex: Heads up — Customer 'GlacierApps' reporting repeated 500/503s on hosted API for authenticated toolcalls. They see spikes around 10:12-10:15 UTC and then steady increased errors. Logs show upstream infer-worker exit + container restart.

alex: Minimal repro attached by CS: single request with tool_call and a ~200k token context, not always reproducible locally. 

maya: @alex can you paste the worker logs? suspecting GPU OOM or segfault from the description.

alex: paste of /var/log/infer-runner/out.log: ```
[10:12:03] runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f8a23...
[10:12:03] signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 0 (SI_USER)
[10:12:03] infer-runner(1234): jitted-kernel-alloc failed
[10:12:04] infer-runner(1234): GPU memory exceed, aborting
[10:12:04] containerd: killing container infer-runner (exit 137)
```

kevin: exit 137 = OOM-kill, but segfault log too. Could be driver + kernel panic on large KV cache. Which GPU type?

alex: NVIDIA A100-40GB pool. Customer's batch size is 1 but context huge.

sara: Large context + toolcall can spike KV prefetch. We've seen mem ballooning if quant profile changes. Any recent quant swap on that pool?

deploy-bot: [deployment 2026-03-17T09:58Z] rolled model-quant-swap v2 -> v3 to pool a100-40-1

maya: ah. possible regression introduced by v3 quant kernels. @kevin can you check node-level dmesg for GPU driver resets?

kevin: grep from host dmesg: ```
[Mar17 10:12:02] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[Mar17 10:12:05] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (infer-runner) total-vm:150000000kB
```

alex: Customer is on the phone. CS wants ETA and mitigation. They say auth tokens not accepted intermittently and retries are causing cascading failures.

maya: Immediate mitigation: 1) route customer traffic to a different pool (a100-80 or cpu fallback) 2) rollback quant-swap on that pool 3) enable per-customer max_context enforcement to prevent KV prefetch blowout.

kevin: I can route to a100-80 pool and add a temporary routing rule for GlacierApps. On it now.

kevin: routing rule applied. traffic rerouted at 10:18:22 UTC.

alex: CS confirms error rate dropped to normal after reroute. They still see a couple failed auth attempts from retries but overall steady.

sara: For next steps: run a stress repro against v3 quant on an A100-40 simulating 200k token stream, with KV prefetch enabled. I'll own repro and bisect.

maya: Also open a rollback PR for model-quant v3 on that pool. tagging infra and runtime.

alex: I'll update the customer: we routed traffic and are rolling back quant patch if repro hits. Apologized for impact and offered 24h free credits.

kevin: Found node-level core dump at /var/crash/infer-runner. Uploading to /tmp/artifacts/6623451111/core.tgz

maya: Good. Attach core + logs to the incident ticket and start bisecting kernels in the runtime repo: try disabling aggresive kernel fusing and re-run.

sara: Repro notes I'll add to the ticket: 
- request: authenticated toolcall with tool name `fetch_big_context`
- context: synthetic 200k tokens (split into streaming chunks)
- env: a100-40, runtime v1.14, quant-v3
- flags: kv_prefetch=on, batch=1, stream=true

alex: Final for now — customer escalated to P2, routing fix mitigated production impact. We're keeping this thread open until rollback or fix confirmed.

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll start the runtime PR and link to this thread.

deploy-bot: [rollback] model-quant v2 restored to pool a100-40-1 (2026-03-17T11:05Z)

alex: CS confirmed no further 5xxs after rollback. Closing loop with customer and scheduling follow-up postmortem.
